title: tests.py full run exceeds the darwin seconds ceiling by 1 to 8 s on a loaded host while all 100 tests pass
goal: python3 _tools/tests.py exits 0 on the darwin development host under the load of a sprint's parallel workers: the full run stays within the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json, or the slowest tests are cut, without raising the ceiling (full runs of 22 to 23 s with every test passing on a host where several workers queue on the host lock showed it, 23.6 to 23.9 s of the 24 s ceiling on a quiet worktree when this was planned); first cut: the four land scenarios of _tools/test_land_e2e.py (9 to 12 s each alone in a tests.py _tools/test_land_e2e.py --durations=5 run on this host, the folded gone-once, dry-run and reopened_refs one 10.7 s) each run under 8 s alone with every assertion kept (shared fixture, fewer git and backlog.py subprocesses)

run: import re,subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/tests.py","_tools/test_land_e2e.py","--no-reuse","--durations=5"],capture_output=True,text=True);t=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r"^(\d+\.\d+)s call",p.stdout,re.M)];sys.exit(1 if p.returncode or not t or max(t)>=8 else 0)

clauses.clause: python3 _tools/tests.py exits 0 on the darwin development host under the load of a sprint's parallel workers: the full run stays within the ceiling in _tools/tests_ceiling.json, or the slowest tests are cut, without raising the ceiling (full runs of 22 to 23 s with every test passing on a host where several workers queue on the host lock showed it, 23.6 to 23.9 s of the 24 s ceiling on a quiet worktree when this was planned)

first cut: the four land scenarios of _tools/test_land_e2e.py (9 to 12 s each alone in a tests.py _tools/test_land_e2e.py --durations=5 run on this host, the folded gone-once, dry-run and reopened_refs one 10.7 s) each run under 8 s alone with every assertion kept (shared fixture, fewer git and backlog.py subprocesses)

notes: Evidence (SP-4phd36pa to SP-df2cu4uj closes, 2026-10-11/12): the review story's done was refused one to nine times on the whole suite, 100 tests passing in 21.9 to 23.0 s pytest time (done rows 22.9 to 23.3 s) against the 22 s darwin ceiling (24 s since D-kl72euxy), at load 2 to 5 on 14 cores, and passed on a later run; under a game's load 160 to 193 s, with Spotlight and a distill near 100% CPU 30 s. BG-e5l2pzys (22.28 s on a clean clone with no other run) was dropped as a duplicate; backlog.py ops SP-wwacrsqr lists the done.refused rows. Absorbed from BG-ucwq6kga (SP-lyfnpu37 and SP-ciqk6gt6, 2026-10-10, 20 s ceiling then): 23 to 40 s with four workers on the host lock; its own-run-time measure cannot be told from wall time, so none is planned. Absorbed from ST-ogknl5av: the folded e2e scenario ran 11 to 12.9 s alone. Premise run 2026-10-12 at planning (14 cores, load near 3, another planner's run on the host lock): tests.py --no-reuse took 23.61 s and 23.89 s of the 24 s ceiling with 100 passed (the second refused, 24 s), and precheck's repro run 30.3 s with 100 passed, refused over 24 s: it reproduces. A tests.py _tools/test_land_e2e.py --durations=5 run shows four tests at 9.3 to 11.7 s (the folded scenario 10.7 s) and in the full run 11.9 to 14.5 s each, the critical path of the run. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 14 of 19, "The whole suite fits its seconds ceiling under host load without the ceiling changing"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
